value.descriptionShort: Harbingerkin are grotesque but cunning corrupt phytokin with an affinity for harbinger trees. They can consume raw flesh without negative effects, dispose of corpses by eating them, and reproduce by planting sapling children near harbinger trees.

value.description: Unlike standard phytokin, who were genetically engineered to connect with plant life of all kinds, harbingerkin are abominations created by the corrupting touch of a harbinger tree on the sensitive psyche and developing body of a sapling child. Like their mothers, they can subsist on sunlight alone, but their ravenous hunger for meat makes them excellent herders and hunters. While they still draw genetic satisfaction from growing and planting, they do not share their mothers' natural skill at caring for plants.\n\nThis xenogerm has been corrupted by the void energy of harbinger trees, creating a symbiosis with the trees and their hunger for raw flesh. Harbingerkin can consume raw meat, even raw human flesh, without mental or physical downsides, and in fact have an unnatural need to do so. They can also plant spores in a corpse on a semi-regular basis to produce a harbinger tree. Any sapling child planted near a harbinger tree has a high chance of being infected and twisted into a harbingerkin.
